verdicts.reason: A: The long headline is crammed into a narrow left column and wraps into 9 lines, taking over half the canvas. The CTA floats at the top right above a tiny product, and the Sunset Sale and Small Batch badges are scattered in the middle, so the reading order is jumbled. B: The headline spans the width and reads clearly, but the legal text sits directly under the headline and above the body copy. The product can is gone, the Sunset Sale tag is clipped at the top-left corner, the CTA is crammed into a row with the badges, and a missing-asset placeholder overlaps at the right edge. B is still the more coherent of the two.
